# teams_files_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing FilesPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `default_file_upload_app_id` (String) Maps to the -DefaultFileUploadAppId parameter.
- `file_sharing_in_chatswith_external_users` (String) Maps to the -FileSharingInChatswithExternalUsers parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `native_file_entry_points` (String) Maps to the -NativeFileEntryPoints parameter.
- `sp_channel_files_tab` (String) Maps to the -SPChannelFilesTab parameter.
